description: Verify a newly installed Lab candidate, including Gen-4 workflow graphs, before promoting it to last-known-good.
name: lab-candidate-verify

steps.command:
python3 - <<'PY2'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
b=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/etc/optiplex-lab/build.json').read_text()); s=pathlib.Path('/opt/optiplex-lab/server.py'); h=hashlib.sha256(s.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert b.get('source_sha256')==h; assert b.get('recovery_state')=='CANDIDATE_INSTALLED'; print('CANDIDATE_BUILD_OK',h)
PY2
